head_coach.name: Carlo Ancelotti
head_coach.play_style_summary: A highly fluid tactical system transitioning between 4-3-3 and 4-2-3-1. It emphasizes structured positional play, utilizing high pressing, dynamic wing play, and rapid defensive transitions.

key_players.name: Vinicius Junior
key_players.performance_stats: Remains the most valuable asset in the Seleção squad, acting as a premier dribbler and direct attacking threat for Real Madrid and Brazil.

key_players.name: Raphinha
key_players.performance_stats: In sensational form for both FC Barcelona and the national team, establishing himself as one of the squad's primary creative engines and goal scorers.

key_players.name: Gabriel Magalhaes
key_players.performance_stats: Serves as a vital defensive leader after helping guide Arsenal to the UEFA Champions League final, offering physical dominance and stability at the back.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Ruled out of the 2026 World Cup after undergoing surgery on a torn biceps femoris tendon in his left leg.
Excluded from the squad after sustaining a severe ACL and meniscus injury in his right knee in early May.
Though named in the official squad, his initial availability is in doubt after suffering a moderate muscle edema in his right calf.
